Use case: identity-preserve sprite animation. Image1 is our OWN mounted hero-class identity reference. Paint a NEW eleven-pose VICTORY gesture atlas, matching the same person, pony, tack, equipment, proportions, camera and upper-left lighting. Do not repeat copied or translated idle cells.

TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas1536x2048: exactly THREE columns by FOUR rows of equal SQUARE cells, ELEVEN used poses in row-major order; cell12 EMPTY. No background, floor, cast shadow, labels, gridlines, borders or text. Horse/person fully contained with transparent gutters. Hooves share fixed local baseline near y480 in a nominal512cell. Full standing/rider height, pony size and saddle position identical across all cells. RIGHT-facing three-quarter camera as image1. Do not move the pony across the frame, zoom, mirror or change its coat.

The mounted commander celebrates without attacking or casting. Pony remains planted. Free-hand salute rises DIAGONALLY OUTWARD to about head height, not a straight overhead arm that clips the cell. Highest glove stays below top margin16 and the helmet/hood remains wholly visible.
Eleven real consecutive stages:
1 upright neutral, gaze forward.
2 chin raises, shoulders draw back.
3 free hand leaves reins, elbow bends.
4 hand lifts in front of chest.
5 arm opens diagonally outward, glove at shoulder height.
6 triumphant bent-arm salute, glove reaches near head height.
7 holds strongest clear salute, face pleased, pony head a little lifted.
8 free arm begins lowering toward shoulder.
9 hand descends in front of chest.
10 reaches reins, posture relaxes.
11 returns close to quiet mounted holding.
Keep wrench strapped to belt. If staff carried, it stays in its supporting hand and flask shape remains unchanged while the free hand salutes. No extra props, flags, fire or magic. Distinct articulated head/shoulder/elbow/hand poses, not repeated frames.

Original1999 HeroesIII prerendered-painted game sprite, rough wool/leather, worn iron/brass, rich restrained colors and tactile pony coat. No glossy modern3D, cartoon, anime, pixel filter, chibi or champion likeness. Must remain a compact understandable animated commander at150x175. Identity: An older male human field chemist with light-brown skin, narrow short gray beard, dark-brown hood, long patched charcoal-green coat, ochre scarf, leather vial harness and brown boots. He holds a straight dark-wood staff tipped by a small caged amber glass reagent flask, not a holy symbol. He rides a compact shaggy chestnut pony with rough dark leather tack and a plain muted teal saddle blanket. No knight plate, official champion likeness, white-and-gold robe, neon crystals, gas covering face or robot body.
